{{Top|leg}}
The '''bellows horn''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument developed by the [[Ruurian/Legends|Ruurians]] incorporating a small bellows to pump [[Atmosphere|air]] to the horn. It was usually played in concert with a pair of hammer-dulcimers, two [[tympanic pulser]]s, and a flute. Due to their multi-legged anatomy, one Ruurian could play all the instruments simultaneously.
